description.zh:
待灰度迁移的设备名称列表。

单次调用本接口，最多传入10个设备名称。超出10个的设备名称会被直接丢弃。
description.en:
The list of device names to be grayscale migrated.  

You can specify up to 10 device names in a single API call. Any device names beyond 10 will be discarded directly.
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices belong.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
实例迁移时，如果有新增设备未灰度迁移，可以调用本接口持续灰度迁移增量设备。

调用本接口前，已在[物联网平台控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/)创建灰度迁移任务，并灰度验证完成，任务已处于灰度完成状态。具体操作，请参见[实例迁移](~~353160~~)。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
During instance migration, if new devices have not undergone grayscale migration, you can call this API to continuously migrate incremental devices in grayscale mode.  

Before calling this API, you must have created a grayscale migration job in the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/), completed grayscale verification, and ensured that the job is already in the grayscale-completed status. For detailed steps, see [Instance Migration](~~353160~~).  

## QPS Limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 5 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-gray-migration-device --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-names example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
